scope: Text-only review of supplied N80 experiment plan; no file or server access
adopted_advice: Keep N98 reference and N80 first, defer N70. Compare both physical fields with own-N and common-N80 windows, recording floor, peak and full envelope.
Use a matched same-server N98/N80 family to avoid confounding server differences; assess physical mirror coupling separately from domain/PML changes.
A 150ps length pair can measure finite-duration width sensitivity, while gradient temporal checks remain separate. It does not certify N80 temporal convergence or production readiness.
Keep existing time monitors and inspect late-time behavior as supporting data; any needed N80 duration rung requires measured review, not automatic release.
corrections_and_limits: N80 crop effect .151520946um divided by Tout100to150 width drift .000390350399um is about388, not40. Modal comparison is about174. These are ratios of measured changes, not error bounds.
Nearby-wavelength width spread and a single duration difference are not resolution/noise thresholds. They cannot certify that a physical length effect is resolved or absent.

A changed mirror-envelope slope, even near the cavity, may follow physical mirror feedback; it does not prove a numerical artifact. Same-window width difference remains affected by finite-time/discretization error.

A nonzero floor alone does not invalidate the defined relative-floor FWHM. Missing or edge-crossing halfheight requires inspection; report the metric convention rather than substitute an unapproved width.
Ten cells per pitch does not imply physical ends are mesh nodes: quarter-pitch and actual origin matter. Preserve the exact locked grid and actual physical coordinates; do not round geometry to grid.

N80 evaluated over N98 coverage includes extended feeds but does not mostly sample feed: the added mirror-to-feed length is roughly18 percent of N98 grating extent. Treat it as a supplemental observable.
Lower Q/faster decay for a shorter mirror is a hypothesis here, not guaranteed by N alone. A late-time point probe is not a rigorous spatial-FWHM convergence bound.
Saving a100ps snapshot inside a150ps run is not a demonstrated available extraction path; do not claim this implemented or equivalent to a complete matched100ps solve.
release: N80/N98 hiddenCAD preparation only at this stage; no length solve yet. Global gradient calibration remains failed.
